name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Analytics Implementation & Marketing Technology Specialist | Google Tag Manager, GA4, Conversion Tracking, Multi-Client Agency Operations
summary: Marketing technology operator who builds, debugs, and maintains the tracking behind client marketing programs. At Solenzo I deploy Google Tag Manager on every client site (custom triggers and variables, GA4 events, Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversions), debug in Preview mode and browser DevTools, enforce UTM conventions, configure cookie consent, and validate that conversion data reaches the CRM through webhooks and APIs. Agency background managing several client accounts at once, working SQL (BigQuery/GA4), and 18 published articles explaining tracking and attribution to non-technical readers.
